text: ing should not be inferred from the absence of a statement for any drug. Doses Doses are described under the Uses and Administration heading with as much detail as is necessary and available. Unless otherwise stated the doses represent the average range of quantities which are generally regarded as suitable for adults when given by mouth. More information on doses and drug administration may be given in the abstracts or reviews. Unless otherwise specified, glucose injection is 5% w/v and sodium chloride injection is 0.9% w/v. When doses for children are expressed as a range of quantities within specified age limits, the lower dose applies at the lower age and the higher dose at the higher age.
